# Alphaday

> A crypto data layer. One REST API and one MCP server over market data,
> on-chain metrics, news, governance, research, podcasts, video, events and
> security incidents — aggregated, normalised and queryable from a single
> surface. Public reads need no account, no API key and no signup.

Alphaday aggregates crypto's fragmented sources into typed, queryable
collections. The same data powers the dashboards at https://alphaday.com and the
programmatic surfaces below; the product is the shop window, the layer is
the thing.

This file is generated at build time from the live API spec and a live MCP
tools/list call. Generated: 2026-09-14

## Start here

- [OpenAPI spec](https://alphaday.com/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.0.3 description of all 59 REST endpoints. Also served at https://api.alphaday.com/openapi.json
- [MCP endpoint](https://api.alphaday.com/mcp): streamable HTTP, protocol 2025-06-18 (v1.30.0), 57 tools. No credentials required
- [MCP setup guide](https://alphaday.com/mcp): what the server holds and how to connect each client
- [API overview](https://alphaday.com/api): what the layer covers and how to reach it
- [Endpoint reference](https://alphaday.com/api/docs): browsable reference for every endpoint

## Authentication

Public reads are open — no account, no key, no signup. Verified against the
live API: `curl https://api.alphaday.com/items/news/` returns 200 with no headers set.

The OpenAPI document declares `tokenAuth` and `cookieAuth` on every
operation. That reflects the optional per-user layer, not a requirement:
personalised endpoints (`/items/*/bookmarks/`) return 401 anonymously, while
every public collection returns 200. Per-user fields such as
`is_bookmarked` and `is_liked` are the reason the schemes are declared.

## Connecting an agent

```bash
# REST — no auth
curl https://api.alphaday.com/items/news/

# Filter and paginate
curl "https://api.alphaday.com/items/news/?limit=10&page=1"
```

MCP client configuration:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "alphaday": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://api.alphaday.com/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

59 endpoints across 16 collections, all
under `https://api.alphaday.com`.

- **News** (6 endpoints) — `/items/news/`
- **Events** (5 endpoints) — `/items/events/`
- **Videos** (5 endpoints) — `/items/videos/`
- **Market** (6 endpoints) — `/market/coins/`
- **TVL Suite** (8 endpoints) — `/tvl/fees/`
- **Podcasts** (4 endpoints) — `/items/podcasts/`
- **Blogs** (4 endpoints) — `/items/blogs/`
- **DAO** (3 endpoints) — `/items/dao/`
- **Forum** (3 endpoints) — `/items/forum/`
- **Coins & Categories** (4 endpoints) — `/coins/categories/`
- **Exchanges** (2 endpoints) — `/exchanges/`
- **On-chain DEXes** (2 endpoints) — `/onchain-dexes/`
- **Security & Exploits** (2 endpoints) — `/security/exploits/`
- **Trending Keywords** (2 endpoints) — `/keywords/trending/`
- **Kasandra AI** (1 endpoint) — `/kasandra/patterns/{coin}/`
- **Tags & Projects** (2 endpoints) — `/tags/`


## MCP tools

57 tools on `alphaday` v1.30.0. Call `get_server_instructions` first — the server says so in its own
initialize response.

- `get_server_instructions` — Return MCP server instructions (if any). Always call first.
- `get_fear_greed_index` — GET get for fear & greed index.
- `get_market_coins` — **Coin prices & market data.** Continuously-updated market snapshots for the top coins by rank — price, market cap and volume.
- `get_market_coins_history` — **Coin price history.** Historical price, market-cap and volume series for one coin, returned as a single object (not a paginated list). Set the window with range: 1D, 1W,…
- `get_market_coins_detail` — **Get a single coin's market data.** Current market data for one coin by ID, slug — price, market cap and volume.
- `get_market_trending` — **Trending coins.** The coins trending right now, ranked by score, with price and 24h change.
- `get_market_trending_detail` — **Get a single trending coin.** Fetch one trending-coin snapshot by its ID.
- `get_tvl_fees` — **Protocol fees & revenue.** Fee and revenue data across DeFi protocols — 24h, 7d and 30d totals plus revenue. Filter by project, project type (protocol/chain) or tags.
- `get_tvl_fees_top` — **Top protocols by fees/revenue.** The top protocols ranked by fees or revenue over a timeframe, as a {protocols: {config, data}} object (not a paginated list).
- `get_tvl_fees_detail` — **Get a single protocol's fees.** Fee and revenue data for one protocol by its ID.
- `get_tvl_yields` — **Yield pools (APY).** DeFi yield pools with APY (base and reward), TVL and impermanent-loss risk. Filter by chain, project or pool symbol.
- `get_tvl_yields_top` — **Top yield pools by APY or TVL.** The top yield pools ranked by APY or TVL, as a {pools: {config, data}} object (not a paginated list). Powered by DefiLlama.
- `get_tvl_yields_detail` — **Get a single yield pool.** Data for one yield pool by its ID.
- `get_tvl_stablecoins` — **Stablecoins.** Stablecoin data — peg type and mechanism, price and circulating supply. Filter by symbol, peg type or name. Use the detail endpoint for the…
- `get_tvl_stablecoins_detail` — **Get a single stablecoin.** Data for one stablecoin by its ID.
- `get_blogs` — **Latest crypto blog posts.** Browse blog and research posts aggregated from 130+ project and research feeds. Filter by project (tags), source, publication date or time period.
- `get_trending_blogs` — **Trending blog posts.** The posts getting the most attention right now, ranked by trendiness. Optionally narrow with tags.
- `get_blogs_detail` — **Get a single blog post.** Fetch one blog post by its ID, with full detail.
- `get_dao` — **DAO governance proposals.** Browse live governance proposals and votes across DAOs, with start and end dates. Filter by project (tags), active-only, or start/end date.
- `get_trending_dao` — **Trending DAO proposals.** The proposals drawing the most attention right now, ranked by trendiness. Optionally narrow with tags.
- `get_dao_detail` — **Get a single DAO proposal.** Fetch one DAO proposal by its ID, with full detail.
- `get_events` — **Upcoming crypto events.** Browse the crypto events calendar — conferences, community calls, token unlocks and more. Filter by event type, date range (period_after /…
- `get_events_subscriptions` — **Your subscribed events.** The events the signed-in user has subscribed to. Returns an empty list for unauthenticated requests.
- `get_events_this_week` — **Events happening this week.** A lightweight list of event titles scheduled for the current week, Monday to Sunday (up to 200).
- `get_trending_events` — **Trending events.** The events drawing the most attention right now, ranked by trendiness. Optionally narrow to projects with tags.
- `get_events_detail` — **Get a single event.** Fetch one event by its ID, with full detail.
- `get_forum` — **Crypto governance forum posts.** Browse discussion posts from 50+ governance and community forums. Filter by project (tags), source, publication date or time period.
- `get_trending_forum` — **Trending forum posts.** The forum discussions getting the most attention right now, ranked by trendiness. Optionally narrow with tags.
- `get_forum_detail` — **Get a single forum post.** Fetch one forum post by its ID, with full detail.
- `get_news` — **Latest crypto news headlines.** Browse real-time crypto news aggregated from ~50 outlets, each with a sentiment score and source. Filter by project (tags), source, sentiment,…
- `get_news_last_24_hours` — **News from the last 24 hours.** A lightweight list of news titles published in the last 24 hours (up to 200) — handy for quick briefings and LLM prompts.
- `get_news_summary` — **AI summary of the news.** An AI-generated briefing of recent crypto news. Optionally focus it on specific projects by passing tags.
- `get_trending_news` — **Trending news.** The crypto news drawing the most engagement right now, ranked by a trendiness score. Optionally narrow to projects with tags.
- `get_news_detail` — **Get a single news article.** Fetch one news article by its ID, with full detail.
- `get_podcasts` — **Latest crypto podcasts.** Browse crypto podcast episodes aggregated from ~120 feeds, with audio URL and duration. Filter by project (tags), source, publication date or time…
- `get_trending_podcasts` — **Trending podcasts.** The podcast episodes drawing the most attention right now, ranked by trendiness. Optionally narrow with tags.
- `get_podcasts_detail` — **Get a single podcast episode.** Fetch one podcast episode by its ID, with full detail.
- `get_videos` — **Latest crypto videos.** Browse crypto video content aggregated from ~120 YouTube channels. Filter by project (tags), source, publication date or time period.
- `get_latest_videos` — **Latest video.** The single most recent video (excluding YouTube Shorts). Optionally scope to projects with tags.
- `get_trending_videos` — **Trending videos.** The videos getting the most engagement right now, ranked by trendiness. Optionally narrow to projects with tags.
- `get_videos_detail` — **Get a single video.** Fetch one video by its ID, with full detail.
- `get_tags` — **Tags.** Browse the tag taxonomy (projects, chains, categories). Filter by item type, keyword ids, or a parent tag's slug to list its children.
- `get_tags_detail` — Retrieve a single tag.
- `get_trending_keywords` — **Trending keywords.** The keywords and topics trending across crypto right now, each with a sentiment score and trendiness metric.
- `get_trending_keywords_detail` — **Get a single trending keyword.** One trending keyword by its ID, with its sentiment and trendiness.
- `get_coin_categories` — **Token categories (sectors).** Cryptocurrency token categories (e.g. DeFi, Layer 1, memecoins), each with aggregate market cap, 24h change, volume and coin count. Filter by name…
- `get_coin_categories_detail` — **Get a single token category.** One token category by its ID, with its aggregate market metadata.
- `get_developer_activity` — **Developer activity.** GitHub developer-activity snapshots per coin — commits, contributors and related metrics over time. Filter by coin or date.
- `get_developer_activity_detail` — **Get a single developer-activity snapshot.** One developer-activity snapshot by its ID.
- `get_exchanges` — **Centralized exchanges.** Centralized exchange (CEX) reference data — trust score, 24h BTC trading volume, country and year established. Filter by country, trading incentive…
- `get_exchanges_detail` — **Get a single exchange.** One centralized exchange by its ID, with its full profile and trust metrics.
- `get_onchain_dexes` — **On-chain DEXes.** Decentralized exchange (DEX) reference data with the blockchain networks each supports. Filter by project (tags, including parent-network tags) or…
- `get_onchain_dexes_detail` — **Get a single DEX.** One decentralized exchange by its ID, with its network tags.
- `get_kasandra_patterns` — **AI-detected chart patterns.** Recent chart patterns Kasandra AI has matched on a coin's market history (e.g. double top, head-and-shoulders), each with a bullish/bearish signal…
- `get_security_exploits` — **Exploits & security incidents.** On-chain exploit and hack alerts sourced from DeFiHackLabs and Rekt.news, with amount lost, chain, protocol and attack type. Filter by chain, attack…
- `get_security_exploits_detail` — **Get a single security incident.** One exploit/security alert by its ID, with its full details.
- `search_projects` — Search project-tagged content across the aggregated superfeed.

# Endpoint reference

## News

### GET /items/news/

**Latest crypto news headlines**
Browse real-time crypto news aggregated from ~50 outlets, each with a sentiment score and source. Filter by project (tags), source, sentiment, publication date or time period.

- Parameters: limit (integer), page (integer), period (string), published_at (string), search (string), sentiment (integer), sources (string), tags (string)
- Returns: paginated of `NewsReadOnly`
- Fields: id, hash, title, url, image, author, published_at, source, is_bookmarked, is_liked, sentiment, sentiment_score, likes
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/items/news/`

### GET /items/news/bookmarks/

**Your bookmarked news**
The signed-in user's saved news. Requires an authenticated request.

- Parameters: none
- Returns: object of `NewsReadOnly`
- Fields: id, hash, title, url, image, author, published_at, source, is_bookmarked, is_liked, sentiment, sentiment_score, likes
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/items/news/bookmarks/`

### GET /items/news/last_24_hours/

**News from the last 24 hours**
A lightweight list of news titles published in the last 24 hours (up to 200) — handy for quick briefings and LLM prompts.

- Parameters: none
- Returns: object of `NewsTitles`
- Fields: titles
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/items/news/last_24_hours/`

### GET /items/news/summary/

**AI summary of the news**
An AI-generated briefing of recent crypto news. Optionally focus it on specific projects by passing tags.

- Parameters: tags (string)
- Returns: object of `NewsSummary`
- Fields: tags, summary, updated_at
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/items/news/summary/`

### GET /items/news/trending/

**Trending news**
The crypto news drawing the most engagement right now, ranked by a trendiness score. Optionally narrow to projects with tags.

- Parameters: none
- Returns: object of `NewsReadOnly`
- Fields: id, hash, title, url, image, author, published_at, source, is_bookmarked, is_liked, sentiment, sentiment_score, likes
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/items/news/trending/`

### GET /items/news/{id}/

**Get a single news article**
Fetch one news article by its ID, with full detail.

- Parameters: id (integer, required)
- Returns: object of `NewsReadOnly`
- Fields: id, hash, title, url, image, author, published_at, source, is_bookmarked, is_liked, sentiment, sentiment_score, likes
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/items/news/123/`

## Events

### GET /items/events/

**Upcoming crypto events**
Browse the crypto events calendar — conferences, community calls, token unlocks and more. Filter by event type, date range (period_after / period_before), active-only, or project (tags).

- Parameters: active (boolean), ends_at (string), ends_at__gt (string), ends_at__gte (string), ends_at__lt (string), ends_at__lte (string), item_type (string), limit (integer), page (integer), period_after (string), period_before (string), sort_by (array), sources (string), starts_at (string), starts_at__gt (string), starts_at__gte (string), starts_at__lt (string), starts_at__lte (string), tags (string)
- Returns: paginated of `EventMini`
- Fields: id, hash, title, item_type, starts_at, ends_at, location, is_subscribed
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/items/events/`

### GET /items/events/subscriptions/

**Your subscribed events**
The events the signed-in user has subscribed to. Returns an empty list for unauthenticated requests.

- Parameters: none
- Returns: object of `EventMini`
- Fields: id, hash, title, item_type, starts_at, ends_at, location, is_subscribed
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/items/events/subscriptions/`

### GET /items/events/this_week/

**Events happening this week**
A lightweight list of event titles scheduled for the current week, Monday to Sunday (up to 200).

- Parameters: none
- Returns: object of `Event`
- Fields: id, hash, title, source, tags, url, is_approved, short_description, description, item_type, organizers, speakers, starts_at, ends_at, location, image, block_number, price, is_subscribed
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/items/events/this_week/`

### GET /items/events/trending/

**Trending events**
The events drawing the most attention right now, ranked by trendiness. Optionally narrow to projects with tags.

- Parameters: none
- Returns: object of `EventMini`
- Fields: id, hash, title, item_type, starts_at, ends_at, location, is_subscribed
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/items/events/trending/`

### GET /items/events/{id}/

**Get a single event**
Fetch one event by its ID, with full detail.

- Parameters: id (integer, required)
- Returns: object of `Event`
- Fields: id, hash, title, source, tags, url, is_approved, short_description, description, item_type, organizers, speakers, starts_at, ends_at, location, image, block_number, price, is_subscribed
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/items/events/123/`

### GET /items/videos/latest/

**Latest video**
The single most recent video (excluding YouTube Shorts). Optionally scope to projects with tags.

- Parameters: none
- Returns: object of `VideoItemReadOnly`
- Fields: id, hash, title, url, published_at, short_description, image, source, is_bookmarked, is_liked, likes

### GET /items/videos/{id}/

**Get a single video**
Fetch one video by its ID, with full detail.

- Parameters: id (integer, required)
- Returns: object of `VideoItem`
- Fields: id, hash, title, url, published_at, short_description, description, image, source, tags, is_bookmarked, is_liked, likes
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/items/videos/123/`

## Market

### GET /market/coins/

**Coin prices & market data**
Continuously-updated market snapshots for the top coins by rank — price, market cap and volume.

- Parameters: limit (integer), page (integer)
- Returns: paginated of `AggregateMarketPrice`
- Fields: id, name, ticker, slug, icon, rank, price, market_cap, volume, price_percent_change_24h, price_percent_change_7d, price_percent_change_30d, high_24h, low_24h, ath, atl, updated_at
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/market/coins/`

### GET /market/coins/history/{id}/

**Coin price history**
Historical price, market-cap and volume series for one coin, returned as a single object (not a paginated list). Set the window with range: 1D, 1W, 1M, 3M, YTD, 1Y, 3Y or ALL (default 1D).

- Parameters: days (integer), id (integer, required), range (string)
- Returns: object of `MarketCoinHistory`
- Fields: id, name, ticker, slug, icon, rank, price, market_cap, volume, price_percent_change_24h, price_percent_change_7d, price_percent_change_30d, high_24h, low_24h, ath, atl, updated_at, history, interval
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/market/coins/history/123/`

### GET /market/coins/{id}/

**Get a single coin's market data**
Current market data for one coin by ID, slug — price, market cap and volume.

- Parameters: id (integer, required)
- Returns: object of `AggregateMarketPrice`
- Fields: id, name, ticker, slug, icon, rank, price, market_cap, volume, price_percent_change_24h, price_percent_change_7d, price_percent_change_30d, high_24h, low_24h, ath, atl, updated_at
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/market/coins/123/`

### GET /market/fear-greed/

**Returns the latest fear & greed index values.**
Optionally filter by asset: ?asset=BTC or ?asset=ETH

- Parameters: asset (string), limit (integer), page (integer)
- Returns: paginated of `FearGreedIndex`
- Fields: id, asset, value, value_classification, timestamp, time_until_update, updated_at
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/market/fear-greed/`

### GET /market/trending/

**Trending coins**
The coins trending right now, ranked by score, with price and 24h change.

- Parameters: limit (integer), page (integer)
- Returns: paginated of `TrendingCoin`
- Fields: id, rank, score, snapshot_time, coin, price, price_percent_change_24h, market_cap
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/market/trending/`

### GET /market/trending/{id}/

**Get a single trending coin**
Fetch one trending-coin snapshot by its ID.

- Parameters: id (integer, required)
- Returns: object of `TrendingCoin`
- Fields: id, rank, score, snapshot_time, coin, price, price_percent_change_24h, market_cap
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/market/trending/123/`

## TVL Suite

### GET /tvl/fees/

**Protocol fees & revenue**
Fee and revenue data across DeFi protocols — 24h, 7d and 30d totals plus revenue. Filter by project, project type (protocol/chain) or tags.

- Parameters: limit (integer), page (integer), project (string), project_type (string), tags (string)
- Returns: paginated of `ProtocolFeesRead`
- Fields: id, project, currency, total_24h, total_7d, total_30d, revenue_24h, revenue_7d, revenue_30d, date
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/tvl/fees/`

### GET /tvl/fees/top/

**Top protocols by fees/revenue**
The top protocols ranked by fees or revenue over a timeframe, as a {protocols: {config, data}} object (not a paginated list).

- Parameters: metric (string), mode (string), timeframe (string)
- Returns: object of `TopProtocols`
- Fields: protocols
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/tvl/fees/top/`

### GET /tvl/fees/{id}/

**Get a single protocol's fees**
Fee and revenue data for one protocol by its ID.

- Parameters: id (integer, required)
- Returns: object of `ProtocolFeesRead`
- Fields: id, project, currency, total_24h, total_7d, total_30d, revenue_24h, revenue_7d, revenue_30d, date
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/tvl/fees/123/`

### GET /tvl/stablecoins/

**Stablecoins**
Stablecoin data — peg type and mechanism, price and circulating supply. Filter by symbol, peg type or name. Use the detail endpoint for the per-chain breakdown.

- Parameters: limit (integer), name (string), page (integer), peg_type (string), symbol (string)
- Returns: paginated of `StablecoinList`
- Fields: id, stablecoin_id, name, symbol, peg_type, peg_mechanism, price, circulating_usd, date
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/tvl/stablecoins/`

### GET /tvl/stablecoins/{id}/

**Get a single stablecoin**
Data for one stablecoin by its ID.

- Parameters: id (integer, required)
- Returns: object of `StablecoinRead`
- Fields: id, stablecoin_id, name, symbol, peg_type, peg_mechanism, price, circulating_usd, chain_data, date
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/tvl/stablecoins/123/`

### GET /tvl/yields/

**Yield pools (APY)**
DeFi yield pools with APY (base and reward), TVL and impermanent-loss risk. Filter by chain, project or pool symbol.

- Parameters: chain (string), limit (integer), page (integer), project (string), symbol (string)
- Returns: paginated of `YieldPoolRead`
- Fields: id, pool_id, project, chain, symbol, apy, apy_base, apy_reward, tvl_usd, il_risk, date
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/tvl/yields/`

### GET /tvl/yields/top/

**Top yield pools by APY or TVL**
The top yield pools ranked by APY or TVL, as a {pools: {config, data}} object (not a paginated list). Powered by DefiLlama.

- Parameters: metric (string)
- Returns: object of `TopPools`
- Fields: pools
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/tvl/yields/top/`

### GET /tvl/yields/{id}/

**Get a single yield pool**
Data for one yield pool by its ID.

- Parameters: id (integer, required)
- Returns: object of `YieldPoolRead`
- Fields: id, pool_id, project, chain, symbol, apy, apy_base, apy_reward, tvl_usd, il_risk, date
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/tvl/yields/123/`

- Parameters: none
- Returns: object of `BlogItemReadOnly`
- Fields: id, hash, title, url, image, author, published_at, source, is_bookmarked, is_liked, likes
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/items/blogs/bookmarks/`

### GET /items/blogs/trending/

**Trending blog posts**
The posts getting the most attention right now, ranked by trendiness. Optionally narrow with tags.

- Parameters: none
- Returns: object of `BlogItemReadOnly`
- Fields: id, hash, title, url, image, author, published_at, source, is_bookmarked, is_liked, likes
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/items/blogs/trending/`

### GET /items/blogs/{id}/

**Get a single blog post**
Fetch one blog post by its ID, with full detail.

- Parameters: id (integer, required)
- Returns: object of `BlogItemReadOnly`
- Fields: id, hash, title, url, image, author, published_at, source, is_bookmarked, is_liked, likes
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/items/blogs/123/`

## Coins & Categories

### GET /coins/categories/

**Token categories (sectors)**
Cryptocurrency token categories (e.g. DeFi, Layer 1, memecoins), each with aggregate market cap, 24h change, volume and coin count. Filter by name or slug.

- Parameters: limit (integer), name (string), page (integer), slug (string)
- Returns: paginated of `CoinCategory`
- Fields: id, slug, name, market_cap, market_cap_change_24h, volume_24h, coin_count, updated_at
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/coins/categories/`

- Parameters: id (integer, required)
- Returns: object of `CoinCategory`

- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/coins/categories/123/`

**Developer activity**
GitHub developer-activity snapshots per coin — commits, contributors and related metrics over time. Filter by coin or date.

- Parameters: date (string), limit (integer), managed (boolean), page (integer), repo_name (string), repo_url (string), sort_by (array)
- Returns: paginated of `DeveloperActivity`
- Fields: id, repo_url, repo_name, commits_last_4_weeks, contributors_count, open_issues, stars, forks, date
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/coins/developer-activity/`

## Exchanges

### GET /exchanges/

**Centralized exchanges**
Centralized exchange (CEX) reference data — trust score, 24h BTC trading volume, country and year established. Filter by country, trading incentive or minimum trust score; sort by trust score, volume, name or age.

- Parameters: country (string), exchange_id (string), has_trading_incentive (boolean), limit (integer), min_trust_score (integer), ordering (string), page (integer), search (string), sort_by (array), tags (string)
- Returns: paginated of `ExchangeReadOnly`
- Fields: id, exchange_id, name, year_established, country, description, url, image, has_trading_incentive, trust_score, trust_score_rank, trade_volume_24h_btc, trade_volume_24h_btc_normalized, tags
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/exchanges/`

### GET /exchanges/{id}/

**Get a single exchange**
One centralized exchange by its ID, with its full profile and trust metrics.

- Parameters: id (integer, required)
- Returns: object of `ExchangeReadOnly`
- Fields: id, exchange_id, name, year_established, country, description, url, image, has_trading_incentive, trust_score, trust_score_rank, trade_volume_24h_btc, trade_volume_24h_btc_normalized, tags
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/exchanges/123/`

**On-chain DEXes**

- Returns: paginated of `OnChainDexReadOnly`
- Fields: id, dex_id, slug, name, description, url, image, volume_1d, volume_1d_change, volume_7d, volume_30d, volume_all_time, tvl, fees_24h, fees_7d, fees_30d, chain, protocol, disabled, rank, market_share, tags
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/onchain-dexes/`

- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/onchain-dexes/123/`

## Security & Exploits

### GET /security/exploits/

**Exploits & security incidents**
On-chain exploit and hack alerts sourced from DeFiHackLabs and Rekt.news, with amount lost, chain, protocol and attack type. Filter by chain, attack type, protocol, minimum amount, date or period; sort by date or amount.

- Parameters: attack_type (string), chain (string), date (string), limit (integer), min_amount (number), page (integer), period (string), protocol (string), sort_by (array), sources (string), tags (string)
- Returns: paginated of `SecurityAlert`
- Fields: id, hash, title, url, image, short_description, description, protocol, amount_usd, chain, attack_type, date, source, tags
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/security/exploits/`

### GET /security/exploits/{id}/

**Get a single security incident**
One exploit/security alert by its ID, with its full details.

- Parameters: id (integer, required)
- Returns: object of `SecurityAlert`
- Fields: id, hash, title, url, image, short_description, description, protocol, amount_usd, chain, attack_type, date, source, tags
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/security/exploits/123/`

## Kasandra AI

### GET /kasandra/patterns/{coin}/

**AI-detected chart patterns**
Recent chart patterns Kasandra AI has matched on a coin's market history (e.g. double top, head-and-shoulders), each with a bullish/bearish signal and confidence score. Filter by interval or pattern type; cap the count with limit (default 20, max 100).

- Parameters: coin (string, required), limit (integer)
- Returns: array of `PatternMatch`
- Fields: id, coin, interval, pattern_type, signal, confidence, start_timestamp, end_timestamp, key_points, modified
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/kasandra/patterns/bitcoin/`

## Tags & Projects

### GET /tags/

**Tags**
Browse the tag taxonomy (projects, chains, categories). Filter by item type, keyword ids, or a parent tag's slug to list its children.

- Parameters: item_type (string), keywords (string), limit (integer), page (integer), parent (string)
- Returns: paginated of `Tag`
- Fields: id, name, slug, keywords, parents
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/tags/`

### GET /tags/{id}/


- Parameters: id (integer, required)
- Returns: object of `Tag`
- Fields: id, name, slug, keywords, parents
- `curl https://api.alphaday.com/tags/123/`

## Notes

- Rate limits are not published. The API is open; use it considerately.
- `https://alphaday.com/sitemap.xml` lists the indexable pages on the marketing site.
- The dashboards at https://alphaday.com and app.alphaday.com are built on this same layer.
